description: Edge case: uptime lands exactly on 0.995. Pins the strict-inequality boundary on below_uptime_minimum — the predicate is `uptime < 0.995`, so uptime=0.995 does NOT fire the flag. All factors set to 0.995 so the composite score is also 0.995, well above the 0.70 performance threshold. A future refactor that changes < to <= would flip this vector and the composite would sit just above probation with no flags.
